title: How to resolve driver app login failures
root_cause: Password was reset in admin but cached token on device was not cleared.
resolution: Have the driver clear app cache and data, then log in with new password. If SSO, verify the user exists in the identity provider.

title: Fixing blank shift board after system update
root_cause: Browser cache holding stale JavaScript bundle after deployment.
resolution: Hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) or clear browser cache. If persistent, check that the dispatch service is running and shift data exists for the selected date range.

title: TankLink device connectivity troubleshooting
root_cause: TankLink device cellular connection lost due to SIM deactivation, weak signal, or power loss.
resolution: 1. Check TankLink device power light (solid green = OK). 2. Check cellular signal (3+ bars). 3. Restart TankLink device by unplugging for 30 seconds. 4. If SIM issue, contact hardware team for replacement.

title: QuickBooks sync failure resolution
root_cause: OAuth token expiry (tokens expire every 100 days) or QBO API rate limit hit.
resolution: 1. Check integration_events table for error details. 2. If token expired, re-authorize via Settings > Integrations > QuickBooks > Reconnect. 3. If rate limited, wait 1 hour and retry.

title: Margin calculation discrepancy on invoices
symptoms: Invoice total doesn't match expected price
root_cause: Multiple: (a) Customer-level override not inheriting to delivery location, (b) Volume-based tier boundary rounding, (c) Tax stack-on-top ordering.
resolution: 1. Verify pricing source badge shows 'Customer' or 'delivery location' correctly. 2. Check effective price breakdown in pricing module. 3. If volume-based, verify gallon range boundaries. 4. For tax issues, check tax component ordering.

title: Route optimization producing suboptimal sequences
root_cause: GPS coordinates on customer addresses are inaccurate (geocoding from address text) or delivery time windows are too tight.
resolution: 1. Verify customer GPS pins on the map. 2. Adjust manually if coordinates are wrong. 3. Review delivery time windows - widen if too restrictive. 4. Re-run optimization after corrections.

title: CSV bulk import errors and formatting
root_cause: CSV encoding issues (must be UTF-8), date format mismatches (expected YYYY-MM-DD), or required fields missing.
resolution: 1. Save CSV as UTF-8 (not UTF-8 BOM). 2. Dates must be YYYY-MM-DD format. 3. Required columns: customer_name, product_type, gallons, delivery_date. 4. Remove any commas within quoted fields that break parsing.

title: Customer portal access setup
root_cause: Customer portal module not activated for this tenant, or user not created in portal admin.
resolution: 1. Verify tenant has customer_portal module active. 2. Go to Admin > Portal Users > Add User. 3. Check spam folder for invitation email. 4. If module not active, customer needs to purchase it.

title: GPS tracking delay troubleshooting
root_cause: Driver app background location permissions revoked by OS power saving, or poor cellular coverage on route.
resolution: 1. Check driver phone settings: Location must be 'Always Allow'. 2. Disable battery optimization for the driver app. 3. Check coverage maps for the delivery area. 4. If persistent, try switching between GPS-only and high-accuracy modes.

title: Handling duplicate delivery orders
symptoms: Customer billed twice for same delivery
root_cause: Double-click on 'Create Order' button before page refresh, or API retry after timeout created duplicate.
resolution: 1. Delete the duplicate order from the shift board. 2. If already delivered/invoiced, create a credit memo for the duplicate. 3. Idempotency keys should prevent this - check if the client is sending unique request IDs.

title: Tank monitor alert threshold configuration
root_cause: Alert threshold set incorrectly, or notification channel (email/SMS) not configured.
resolution: 1. Go to Tank Monitor > Settings > Alert Thresholds. 2. Set critical level (typically 15-20%). 3. Set warning level (typically 25-30%). 4. Verify notification recipients in alert settings. 5. Test with a manual threshold trigger.

title: Dashboard performance optimization
root_cause: Dashboard querying too much historical data. Default date range is 'All Time' which pulls millions of rows.
resolution: 1. Change date range to last 30 or 90 days. 2. Use filters to narrow to specific routes/drivers. 3. If still slow, contact support to check if database indexes need rebuilding.
